brief: Build a Personalized Storytelling Preference Learning system for an audio story platform
objectives: Learn storytelling mechanics per listener (pacing, suspense, dialogue density, emotional tone, description length)
Generate multiple narration variants per segment per session
Train reward model: f(user_profile, story_features, variant) -> reward_score
Implement LoRA adapters on Llama 3 for 5 narration styles
Select/blend LoRA adapters at inference time
